`final class JOIDEnv`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [JOIDEnv.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/JOIDEnv.java)

The mode JOID runs in and the folders where it writes its data and its caches.

## Description

JOID turns dev mode on by itself when the dev classes are on the classpath (the dev jar), and demo mode when the demo classes are.
The folders come from the system properties `joid.data` and `joid.cache` when they are set.

<a id="JOIDEnv-method-devMode"></a>

### devMode

`void devMode(boolean devMode)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The dev mode needs the dev classes of JOID, use its dev jar

Turns dev mode on or off.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when you turn it on without the dev classes of JOID on the classpath.
